EVALUATED.definition: candidate was exact-evaluated against the pinned empirical query/validation law
EVALUATED.negative_evidence: only the exact candidate-specific typed evaluation may be negative evidence for that candidate under the declared law; it says nothing about unevaluated candidates

PRUNED.definition: candidate was inside F but deliberately not exact-evaluated because a declared pruning rule fired
PRUNED.coverage_semantics: pruned candidates remain non-evaluated unless an accepted theorem explicitly provides candidate-specific coverage sufficient for the claimed class

UNEVALUATED.definition: candidate was in F and neither evaluated nor explicitly pruned before execution ended

invariant: evaluated + pruned + unevaluated must exactly partition the authorized frontier F, either by explicit candidate IDs or by nonoverlapping deterministic set descriptors whose union reconstructs F

safe_screen_law.xor_rule: unary-signal screening has no generic no-false-negative theorem for interaction/XOR and therefore cannot support general interaction completeness
broader_claim_requires: exact discovery class and input-semantics applicability
proof that pruned set cannot contain a candidate meeting the declared validation target

allowed: candidate set Y was pruned by rule R
forbidden: no relationship exists when candidates remain unevaluated
low diagnostic score means canonical negative fact
adaptive run was complete absent an accepted safe-coverage theorem
